content: This product information is not a substitute for the advice of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Storage Instructions: Store this product in its original packaging at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Once the foil pouch is opened, the product expires after 60 days in the United States and after 45 days in Canada. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your use. This information is not intended to replace individual medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare professional. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your specific health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most up-to-date information. When sending an offer to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
